The PSGC change-history RDF is built on the [W3C ORG ontology](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-org/)
for organizational structure, with PROV for provenance, Dublin Core Terms for metadata, and
per-snapshot PSGC concepts.

## Namespaces

Namespaces used across the delta files:

- `org:` — [W3C ORG](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-org/) (FormalOrganization for Reg/Prov/City/Mun,
  OrganizationalUnit for Bgy/SubMun)

- `psgc:` — the project's own vocabulary (entity / event / concept URIs — see [URIs](uris.qmd))
- `dct:` — [Dublin Core Terms](https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/)
  (title, source, legal basis metadata)

- `prov:` — [PROV-O](https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/) provenance (linking events to their snapshot
  and source PSA press release)

- `time:` — temporal positioning of effective / plebiscite dates
- `schema:` — [schema.org](https://schema.org/) supplementary terms

## Ontology mapping

### PSGC level → ORG class

Each PSGC level is typed as one of two ORG classes (from `rdf/builder.py`):

| PSGC level | ORG class | Typed as |
|------------|-----------|----------|
| Region (`Reg`) | `org:FormalOrganization` | autonomous top-level unit |
| Province (`Prov`) | `org:FormalOrganization` | |
| Municipality (`Mun`) | `org:FormalOrganization` | |
| City (`City`) | `org:FormalOrganization` | |
| Barangay (`Bgy`) | `org:OrganizationalUnit` | sub-unit |
| Sub-municipality (`SubMun`) | `org:OrganizationalUnit` | sub-unit |

> A **delta** only emits the entities touched by that quarter's changes, so a delta may contain only
`OrganizationalUnit` instances (e.g. the 2023-10-24 delta is all barangays). The `--full` build
emits the entire entity graph with both classes.

### Hierarchy

Parent/child relationships are derived from the [PSGC code structure](../references/psgc.qmd) and
encoded with ORG containment predicates in full builds:

- `org:hasSubOrganization` — FormalOrganization → FormalOrganization (e.g. region → province,
  province → city/municipality).

- `org:hasUnit` — FormalOrganization → OrganizationalUnit (e.g. municipality → barangay).

### Change events

Each change is an `org:ChangeEvent` typed via `org:classification` → a
`psgc:concept/change-type/{type}` concept. The participating entities are attached with
`org:originalOrganization` (the pre-change entity) and `org:resultingOrganization` (the post-change
entity). See [Change-event types](event-types.qmd) for the per-type triple shape.

### Provenance & metadata

Each change event carries its provenance: `dct:source` for the legal basis (Republic Act number,
Executive Order, plebiscite resolution, etc.), `prov:generatedAtTime` for the effective date, and
`dct:description` for a human-readable summary of what changed and why.
